title: CompanyCam CompanyCam Secures Series C Growth Investment

CompanyCam, a Lincoln, Nebraska-based job site productivity platform with field-ready AI, has secured a strategic growth investment in its Series C round.

## Investors

The round was led by B Capital with participation from Decades Holdings and existing investors, including Insight Partners, JMI Equity, Blueprint Equity, Nelnet, Invest Nebraska, and WndrCo.

Founded in 2015, Capital invests globally in extraordinary founders and businesses shaping the future through technology. With more than $9 billion in assets under management and dedicated stage-based funds, the firm focuses on seed to early- and late-stage venture growth investments, primarily in the technology, healthcare, and resilience tech sectors.

## CompanyCam Use of Funds

The investment will support CompanyCam’s growth by scaling its AI-powered platform, deepening integrations with contractors’ existing tools, and expanding globally.

## About CompanyCam

Led by CEO Luke Hansen, CompanyCam provides a job site productivity platform designed to streamline communication and documentation for contractors. Founded in 2015, its platform helps contractors document jobs, communicate with crews, and share progress with clients in real time. Headquartered in Lincoln, Nebraska, CompanyCam serves a variety of trades, including general contractors, HVAC, landscaping, and roofing.
